column1: # 6.88g hero abilities, per level. Source: reference map 6.88g.w3x units/AbilityData.slk, extracted by
# scripts/extract-688g-abilities.mjs from the LNI tables (hy3d). cool_s/cost/dur_s are pipe-separated per-level
# arrays from the archive's own Cool, Cost and HeroDur (falling back to Dur) fields; data is DataA..DataD as
# slash-separated per-level lists; cool_ticks_l1 is level-1 seconds x 16.
# NOT APPLIED. abilities.osd holds only 15 generic ability() rows and none of the 569 hero-ability ids derived
# here, so there is nothing to write to yet. Applying an ability also needs its effect semantics (damage, heal,
# buff, summon), which these rows do not carry - the Data fields are numbers without meaning until read per
# ability. Rows stay pending until those semantics are resolved.
